acceptedInterpretation: The request is a producer-side guard correction plus an operator recovery command, and nothing else. The guard extends its collision predicate to exactly the set of committed verdicts the escalation floor would drift-accept at evaluation time (same materialDigest, or stale materialDigest with storyFilesHash equal to current). It is NOT a request to block all resubmission (genuinely new material with a changed storyFilesHash must still be allowed), NOT a change to the floor drift-accept semantics (eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade stays as-is), and NOT a runId-scheme migration. quorum_prune default keep=newest-material matches the actual B-bf52 recovery precedent (commit 255eefd289 kept the six current-material verdicts and removed the six stale-material ones).
